notes: «حدثنا محمود ... عن هشام بهذا، وزاد ...» names other transmitters (Mahmud, Abu Usama) for the same report with an addition: a variant group, never a route
«قال ابن عيينة وقال ابن جريج المخنث هيت» is a word gloss by commentators, not a link
The Prophet's words are the saying; Umm Salama is the last link
